snippet.title: KALIT DEMO LAUNCH TRAILER | POKEMON meets CUPHEAD and DON’T STARVE
snippet.description:
#Kalit is an open-world game developed only by 2 people with creature collector and survival elements, developed with #unrealengine5.7 and draws inspiration from Pokémon, Cuphead, and Don't Starve. Designed, animated, and colored by hand, it is inspired by vintage animation. Explore a new world, meet magical creatures called Ka, and face dangers and mysteries. Will you survive in this magical world? Adventure awaits you!

*This early version offers a first taste of the gaming experience. Any feedback or suggestion will be valuable to improve it.

DEMO STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3789230/Kalit/
DEMO ITCH.IO: https://traviteam.itch.io/kalit
OFFICIAL DISCORD: https://discord.com/invite/J2MeqUvFCe
